message: `aria-busy="TRUE"` on the part sets the live region of `warning` otherwise than its role does
$reason: A warning part with its `status` and `aria-busy="TRUE"`. Chromium 153 reads it as busy, as it does every value but the empty one, `false` and `undefined` in any case; Firefox 158 hands `TRUE` on as `container-busy` (measured on 2026-10-27). A reading that refused `true` alone, as Firefox's own busy state does, passed it. Point 7 read the part's role and politeness and what may hide it, and passed it.
